info.description: API for NeuralNexus site and services

get.description: Requires the admin:bee-name-generator scope.

post.description: Requires the admin:datastore scope. The store is created for the caller; no request body is read.

get.description: Identifies the store via the request body rather than a path or query parameter.
Identifies the record via the request body rather than a path or query parameter.

delete.description: Requires a valid session, but — unlike create/update — the handler does not check the admin:numberstore scope; any authenticated user can delete any record.

get.description: Get game server simple status
Get game server status

get.summary: Get a Bedrock player's most recently converted skin by XUID
get.description: Looks up a Bedrock player's most recently converted skin, DB-cache-first (24h staleness) with a fallback to Geyser's skin API on a miss or stale entry. Returns 204 (not 404) when the player has no converted skin yet, matching Geyser's own API (200 with an empty object) rather than treating it as a client error.

get.summary: Look up a Bedrock player's XUID and derived UUID by gamertag
get.description: Looks up a gamertag's Xbox XUID, DB-cache-first (24h staleness) with a fallback to Geyser's Xbox XUID lookup API on a miss or stale entry. The UUID is synthesized from the XUID's hex representation (left-padded to 32 hex digits and formatted as a standard UUID) and is never stored; it is not a real Mojang UUID, since Bedrock players have no Mojang profile.

post.summary: Look up players by name in batch
post.description: Body must be a JSON array of 1 to 10 non-empty names; Content-Type must be application/json.

get.summary: Look up a player by name
Look up a player by UUID
Get a player's full profile from Mojang
get.description: Mirrors the Mojang API. Returns 204 (not 404) when the profile can't be found.

get.summary: Get a Bedrock player's full profile (identity + skin) by gamertag
get.description: Looks up a Bedrock player by Xbox gamertag.

get.summary: Get a Bedrock player's full profile (identity + skin) by derived UUID
get.description: Looks up a Bedrock player by their synthetic UUID, derived from an Xbox XUID (see GeyserPlayer.uuid). Returns 400 if the UUID isn't a validly-derived Bedrock UUID.

get.summary: Get a player's full profile by name
get.description: Resolves the name to a UUID via Mojang, then returns the decoded profile. Returns 204 (not 404) when the profile can't be found.
Returns 204 (not 404) when the profile can't be found.

get.summary: Get a Bedrock skin's raw image bytes
get.description: Fetches from the URL embedded in the skin's Value on first request and archives to S3; served straight from S3/CDN thereafter.

get.summary: Get a texture's raw image bytes
get.description: Fetches from Mojang on first request and archives to S3; served straight from S3/CDN thereafter.

Returns a PNG. Which image you get depends on the server:
- The server's own icon, when it reports one.
- default.png, when a Java server reports no icon.
- legacy.png, when a Java server only answers a pre-1.7 status ping, which carries no icon.
- bedrock.png, for bedrock=true. Bedrock servers have no icon, so the server is not contacted.

get.description: Proxies the GitHub releases API. With format=fml, reshapes the response into Forge Mod Loader update-JSON format instead.
Requires a valid session. Always resolves to the caller's own account - equivalent to GET /users/{user_id} with the caller's own ID.

delete.summary: Unlink a platform from the caller's own account
delete.description: Requires a valid session. Always operates on the caller's own account. Refused with 400 if this is the account's last usable login method (no password and no other verified, login-enabled linked platform).

patch.summary: Enable or disable a linked platform for login on the caller's own account
patch.description: Requires a valid session. Always operates on the caller's own account. Disabling is refused with 400 under the same last-usable-login-method guard as DELETE on this resource. Enabling is refused with 400 if the linked account isn't verified.

get.summary: List the caller's own linked platforms
get.description: Requires a valid session. Always resolves to the caller's own linked accounts.
Requires a valid session. Always resolves to the caller's own permissions.

get.summary: Get the caller's own account settings
get.description: Requires a valid session. Always resolves to the caller's own settings.

patch.summary: Update the caller's own account settings
patch.description: Requires a valid session. Always operates on the caller's own account. Disabling password login is refused with 400 unless another verified, login-enabled platform is linked; enabling it is refused with 400 if no password is set.

get.summary: Get a user by their linked-platform identity
get.description: Requires the admin:users scope.
Requires a valid session; any authenticated user may look up any other user by ID.

delete.summary: Unlink a platform from a user
delete.description: Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is unlinking their own account. Refused with 400 if this is the account's last usable login method (no password and no other verified, login-enabled linked platform).

patch.summary: Enable or disable a linked platform for login
patch.description: Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is updating their own account. Disabling is refused with 400 under the same last-usable-login-method guard as DELETE on this resource. Enabling is refused with 400 if the linked account isn't verified.

get.description: Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is requesting their own linked accounts.
Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is requesting their own permissions.
Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is requesting their own settings.

patch.description: Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is updating their own account. Disabling password login is refused with 400 unless another verified, login-enabled platform is linked; enabling it is refused with 400 if no password is set.

Account.description: A user account. Write-only fields (email, password hash, salt) are never serialized.

PlatformData.description: Platform-specific linked-account data. Shape depends on the platform: for 'discord' this mirrors a Discord user object, for 'minecraft' a Mojang profile, for 'twitch' a Twitch user object, for 'xboxlive' an XUID/gamertag pair, for 'microsoft' a plain Microsoft account identity (sub/name/email). Sent as-is to the provider's account-linking record.

LinkedAccount.description: One platform linked to an account.

verified.description: Whether this link was established through a real, cryptographically-proven OAuth or OpenID flow.

login_enabled.description: Whether this platform can currently be used to log in, independent of verified.

password_auth.description: Whether the account can log in with its password.
Whether the account can log in with its password.

profileActions.description: Only present on GET /mc/mojang/profile/{uuid}. Absent entirely on name/UUID lookups, which never populate it; an empty array means the profile was fetched and genuinely has no actions.

metadata.description: Only present for the slim (Alex) model.

MCProfile.description: A player's full profile with its textures decoded.

profileActions.description: Omitted when the profile has no actions.

textures.description: Omitted when the player has no textures property.

prime_subj.description: Pet ID of the picture's primary subject.

othr_subj.description: Pet IDs of any other pets in the picture.

GeyserPlayer.description: A Bedrock player's identity derived from Geyser's Xbox XUID lookup.

uuid.description: Synthesized from the XUID, not a real Mojang UUID.

GeyserSkin.description: A Bedrock player's most recently converted skin, as returned by Geyser's skin API.

is_steve.description: True for the classic (Steve) model, false for slim (Alex).

signature.description: The signature of the skin data used by Minecraft.

texture_id.description: The texture ID used by Minecraft.

value.description: Base64-encoded skin property value, same shape as a Mojang textures property value.

GeyserProfile.description: A Bedrock player's full profile: identity plus their most recently converted skin.

uuid.description: Synthesized from the XUID, not a real Mojang UUID.

PlatformSlug.name: platform
PlatformSlug.description: One of: discord, minecraft, twitch, xboxlive, microsoft.

MCHashSlug.name: hash
MCHashSlug.description: Texture hash, as referenced by a profile's textures property.

FormatQuery.name: format
FormatQuery.description: Set to 'fml' to get Forge Mod Loader update-JSON format instead of a plain release list.

UnsignedQuery.name: unsigned
UnsignedQuery.description: Set to 'false' to request signed texture properties.

MCStatusQueryQuery.name: query
MCStatusQueryQuery.description: Is query enabled on the server

MCStatusQueryPortQuery.name: query_port
MCStatusQueryPortQuery.description: Java only: the UDP query port used when query is enabled. Defaults to the server port when omitted or invalid (not a number, or outside 1-65535). Ignored for bedrock servers.

GamertagSlug.name: gamertag
GamertagSlug.description: Xbox gamertag of a Geyser Bedrock player.

BedrockUUIDSlug.name: uuid
BedrockUUIDSlug.description: A Bedrock player's synthetic UUID, derived from their Xbox XUID (see GeyserPlayer.uuid). Not a real Mojang UUID.

BedrockGamertagNameSlug.name: name
BedrockGamertagNameSlug.description: Xbox gamertag of a Geyser Bedrock player. Named 'name' for path symmetry with /mc/profile/name/{name}.

Retry-After.description: The time after which the request can be retried, as an HTTP-date.
